tenderSchedule.title: Agriculature Feeder Solarisation under CM-SKY Scheme
tenderSchedule.description: Selection of Solar Power Generators (SPGs) on the basis of Build Own & Operate (BOO) for Design, Survey, Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning, Operation & Maintenance of grid connected distributed solar power plants for solarization of selected Agriculture (EIP) feeders at Sub-Station (SS) level, its associated 11kV line to connect the plant with concerned SS and Remote Monitoring System (RMS) of solar power plants through RESCO mode, for 25 years under CM-SKY Scheme in HESCOM jurisdiction.(Re-Call Prject 012 & 022).

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All conditions as per Bid documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be in existence as any of the following: a) Body incorporated in India under the Companies Act, 1956/2013 including any amendment thereto. b) Body incorporated in India under the Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Act, 2008 including any amendment thereto. c) Firm registered under Partnership Act, 1932 in India. d) Firm registered under Societies Registration Act, 1860/The Karnataka Societies Registration Act, 1960 in India. e) Sole Proprietor incorporated in India. In case of Consortium, all the members must fulfill this requirement and shall upload the documents as per this RFP. Certificate of Incorporation issued by the registrar of Companies as per Companies Act 1956/2013 along with MOA and AOA OR The Certificate issued by the Registrar of Firms as per Indian Partnership Act 1932 OR The Certificate issued by the Directorate of Industries & Commerce OR The Certificate issued by the Registrar of Society as per Societies Act, 1860/1960 OR The Registration Certificate issued by Statutory Authority, as applicable shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall propose commercially established technology only and at least one project not less than 1MW capacity based on this technology is successfully operational for at least one year. tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have positive Minimum net worth of INR 1.05 Cr per MW as on 31st March 2026 or as on last date of submission of bid. In case of Consortium, all the partners shall collectively meet this financial criterion. Ex: If the net worth of a Bidder as on 31 March 2026 or as on last date of submission of bid is INR 10.5 Cr, then the bidder is eligible to quote for project covering up to maximum of 10MW capacity only. 1) Certificate fulfilling required financial criteria in the name of Bidder duly certified by Practicing Chartered Accountant as per the format provided in Annexure-V & Annexure-V(A) duly mentioning UDIN shall be uploaded & Scanned copy of the certificate from the Chartered Accountant Independent Auditor for financial Capacity of the Bidder in respect of Individual or Proprietorship Firm or Partnership Firm Accountant as per the format provided in Annexure-V(B). 2) Firms Annual Audited Balance sheet and Profit & Loss statement for FY 2025-26 shall be uploaded. Newly established firms in existence for one year shall upload the latest audited financial statements. In case, audited annual accounts for the FY 2025-26 is not finalized, provisional un-audited annual accounts duly certificated by the Chartered Accountant duly mentioning UDIN shall be uploaded.
